Name: Chess Boards
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod adds an easy-to-use chess board setup to Stardew Valley.


[b][size=5]Chess Boards[/size][/b]

You must create a chess board in order to spawn chess pieces.

Chess boards must fulfill the following criteria:

[list]
[*]be made up of two different alternating flooring tiles
[*]be 8 tiles by 8 tiles in size
[*]not have either of the alternating flooring tiles surrounding them
[*]have no objects places on the board besides spawned chess pieces
[/list]
You can have as many boards as you like on a map as long as they are not touching.


[b][size=5]Chess Pieces[/size][/b]

Chess pieces are modified objects, so they should stay persistent across saves and multiplayer (let me know how it works in MP).

The following hotkeys will work while the mouse cursor is over a chess board:

[list]
[*][b]SetupKey [/b](default [b]J[/b]) - sets up the board with a fresh set of chess pieces
[*][b]FlipKey[/b] (default [b]K[/b]) - rotates the board 180 degrees
[*][b]ClearKey[/b] (default [b]L[/b]) - removes all chess pieces from the board
[/list]
To move a chess piece, click on its square using left mouse button.

You can create your own chess pieces using a Content Patcher Load action targeting the following path:

[b]aedenthorn.ChessBoards/pieces[/b]


[b][size=5]Free Mode[/size][/b]
By default, piece movements are constrained to legal chess moves. Free mode allows you to setup the board as you like and move pieces without constraint.

To toggle free mode, press the [b]ModeKey [/b](default [b]H[/b]) while hovering over a chess board.

During free mode, the following hotkeys become active:

[list]
[*][b]ChangeKey [/b](default [b]Tab[/b]) - cycles the piece at the hovered square through the available piece types, or adds a white pawn at the square if empty.
[*][b]ChangeModKey [/b](default [b]LeftShift[/b]) - if held while pressing [b]ChangeKey[/b], changes piece color instead
[*][b]RemoveKey [/b](default [b]Delete[/b]) - removes the piece at the hovered square
[/list]

[size=5][b]Sound Effects[/b][/size]
You can change the sound effects in the config.

To remove a sound effect, leave the entry empty in GMCM or as "" in the config.json file.

[size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

You can edit the config in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] or by editing the mod's config.json file after starting the game once.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.
